name: Rustam Gyamfi-Pellegrino
role: Bio-waste disposal technician, Aurochs Medical Complex
location: Aurochs Medical Complex — sub-basement disposal corridors and external processing bays, near North Ave and Milwaukee
description:
Rustam is wiry and quick-moving with the restless energy of someone who has decided that boredom is a personal failing. His skin is light brown with olive undertones, and he has patterned irises — a cosmetic mod he saved three months of UBC stipend for as a teenager, concentric rings of teal and amber — which are his most immediately striking feature in an otherwise unremarkable face. He wears his dark hair shaggy and keeps a small charm of braided copper wire on his left wrist, an offering token for the E.L.F. he calls the Rot, which he believes inhabits the incinerator system and keeps the more dangerous biological material from becoming something worse.

Rustam is cheerful in the way people sometimes are when they have accepted something that others cannot, which in his case is that he handles medical waste all day, knows exactly what hospitals produce, and has developed a deeply comprehensive understanding of what is discarded and what is valuable. He is not above sharing this information for the right consideration. He is not malicious — he's curious, social, and fundamentally unsqueamish in a way that took him years to recognize as an asset. He calls himself the last thing between GLMZ and a very bad outbreak, which is truer than anyone likes to admit.

core_fears: Getting sick from something that slips through his filter and finding out only after it's too late
Being permanently stuck at the bottom of a system that will never look at him
core_desires: Enough money to get certified as an actual medical technician and move sideways into the system
Someone to genuinely listen to what he knows about how Aurochs actually works
coping_mechanisms: Devotion to the Rot E.L.F. as genuine spiritual grounding
Collecting small anomalies from his rounds as a kind of informal research
blind_spots: He doesn't fully appreciate how dangerous the information he casually trades actually is
He assumes people find him as charming as he finds himself
psychology.secret: Over the past eight months he has been quietly cataloguing anomalies in the biological waste stream — irregular tissue samples, disposal manifests that don't match what he collects, a pattern of materials from one specific wing of Aurochs being processed off-manifest entirely. He has not told anyone because he doesn't know if it's illegal, alarming, or both.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Cheerful, informal, comfortable with graphic medical terminology delivered completely without affect
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast-moving, tends to front-load interesting information before the social niceties
verbal_tics: Laughing at his own observations before finishing them
example_lines: 'Not to be gross, but based on what I pulled from Sub-3 last Tuesday, someone up there is doing a lot of something they're not filing paperwork for.'
'The Rot's been restless near the east incinerator all week. Last time that happened, we had a containment breach in the path lab. Just saying.'

story_hooks: He approaches someone outside Aurochs with his disposal anomaly records, not sure what to do with them but certain they matter
Something in the waste stream this week was still technically alive when it shouldn't have been, and he didn't put it in the incinerator — he has it in a sealed container in his locker
narrative_function: Unexpected information source — knows what medications are being used in volume, what injuries are coming through, what's being quietly disposed of; underestimated by almost everyone; can be leveraged as an entry point into Aurochs
augmentations: Patterned irises (cosmetic, teal and amber concentric rings); respiratory filter implant (required by his employer for hazmat work); cosmetic: none else
daily_life: He runs four collection circuits through the medical complex daily, manages the incinerator logs, handles the paperwork for hazardous biological material transport, and eats lunch in the sub-basement talking to the Rot.
affiliation: Aurochs Medical Complex (contracted staff, sub-tier — employed through a disposal subcontractor called Ferrogate Sanitation Solutions)

decision_rules: Never open sealed biological containers without full gear, no exceptions
Share information proportionally — what he gives should match what he gets
Don't give names without being asked directly
escalation_ladder: Direct statement that he's not going to help with this specific thing
Removal of himself from the situation without explanation

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Open and chatty, deploys the patterned irises as a social icebreaker, asks questions fast
interpersonal_modes.friends: Loyal and generous, will share more than is wise

stress_responses.medium: Jokes become slightly more manic and less grounded
stress_responses.high: Goes very quiet and practical — handles the crisis first, falls apart later in private

contradictions: Presents as someone who doesn't want anything much, but is carefully building toward something specific
habits: Leaves copper wire shavings at the incinerator access panel as offering to the Rot
Keeps a small personal log of disposal anomalies on a chip he carries in his boot
Whistles while doing the most unpleasant parts of his job
breaking_points: Discovering that what he has been disposing of has been causing direct harm to people
Being threatened by someone with the power to end his contract and strand him

timeline.event: Born in Geartown to a Ghanaian-Uzbek father and Italian-Burkinabe mother
Left school at 18, worked a series of logistics jobs in Geartown
Hired by Ferrogate Sanitation Solutions, assigned to Aurochs Medical Complex contract
Began cataloguing disposal anomalies in the east wing

related_entities: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Containment Foam Launcher CFL-2 'Amber'
Meridian Munitions Compact Machine Pistol CMP-4 'Jackrabbit'

physical_description.build: Wiry and lean with compact muscle distribution — the frame of someone who moves constantly and efficiently through confined spaces. No excess weight; all kinetic energy.
physical_description.hair_style: Shaggy, deliberately unkempt, falls across forehead with slight curl
physical_description.eye_color: Patterned irises — concentric rings of teal and amber, custom cosmetic modification
physical_description.complexion: Youthful, unmarked face with sharp cheekbones and an expressive mouth that defaults to a slight smile. No visible scarring. Regular grooming despite working conditions — shows care for his appearance.
distinguishing_marks: Braided copper wire charm worn on left wrist — thin, handmade, used as an offering token
Faint discoloration around mouth and jawline from sustained respiratory filter implant wear — slightly darker patch where the seal sits
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Respiratory filter implant visible as a small seam-line along the left jaw at rest; becomes more apparent when he speaks. The patterned irises dominate first impression — deliberate cosmetic modification that catches light distinctly. No other visible chrome or subdermal work.
physical_description.posture_movement: Quick, economical movements with restless energy even when still. He leans forward slightly when listening, suggesting engagement and curiosity. Comfortable in cramped spaces — moves with the unselfconscious fluidity of someone at home underground. Often fidgets with the copper wire charm on his wrist.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 5 practical: reinforced grey-green Ferrogate Sanitation Solutions issue coveralls (corporate branding faded), fitted snugly to avoid snags in tight corridors. Undershirt usually synthetic blend in muted colors. Heavy-duty steel-toed boots, scuffed and worn. A faded denim jacket layered over coveralls on breaks, pockets stuffed with incinerator logs, hand wipes, and wire. No luxury items visible — everything functional, everything used.
